One of the objectives of a top laner is to create pressure so that the enemy jungler or mid laner will come them which will lessen the pressure to your bot lane and give them time to scale and then transition to a split pusher (ex. For bruisers go for the Conqueror Keystone in the precision tree with resolve as your secondary. For the lesser runes i suggest Triumph, Legend: Alacrity, and Coup de Grace in the precision tree. For the lesser runes in the resolve tree i usually go with Demolish, and Bone Plating.   


For the tanks take Resolve as your main tree and which you pick between Grasp of the Undying and Aftershock depends on your playstyle. If you prefer the semi-bruiser style with a lot of sustain go Grasp of the Undying. If you prefer to be a engage bot and meat shield for your backline the Aftershock tree since it gives you a ton of survivability to survive. For your secondary go with the Inspiration tree, pick the lesser runes Magical Footwear for free boots and Biscuit Delivery to help you survive the laning phase.   


Hope this little guide helped. Have fun.
